title: Battle & Clash Verbs: megütközik, vereséget szenved

sections.content: When recounting medieval battles, Hungarian uses rich formulaic expressions: *megütközik valakivel* (to clash / engage in battle with someone), *vereséget szenved* (to suffer a defeat), *bekerít* (to encircle / surround), and *elmenekül* (to flee / escape from the battlefield).

sections.title: Battle verbs and expressions
rows: to clash / do battle with someone
to flee / escape from the battle

items.spanish: A magyar sereg Muhinál megütközött a tatárokkal.
items.english: The Hungarian army engaged the Tatars at Mohi.

items.spanish: A királyi hadsereg súlyos vereséget szenvedett.
items.english: The royal army suffered a catastrophic defeat.

items.spanish: IV. Béla az utolsó pillanatban elmenekült a csatamezőről.
items.english: Béla IV escaped from the battlefield at the last moment.

sections.content: *vereséget szenved* is a fixed collocation meaning "to suffer defeat"; its opposite is *győzelmet arat* ("to reap/win victory").
